description: Land Title Settlement Department - Buthpitiya South, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510803
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
